Remaining implementation decisions

Real insurer catalogue, controlling policy wording, regulated operating model, real payment integration, privacy retention, support staffing and deployment budget require their recorded decisions before live use. These gaps stay visible in the wireframes.

Health is the detailed first implementation slice. Term, motor and ULIP use category-specific discovery, comparison and summaries; their final proposal questions must come from the actual source forms.

Display fonts and palette are specified in Tokens & components. The design handoff carries acceptance and evidence requirements.
